name: progress-pane
description: A Progress pane on the right: the steps of the current task, from the built-in TodoWrite or from its own progress tool.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off: the plugin registers nothing (no progress tool, no advice in the system prompt, no pane or band).

view.title: View
view.description: pane: a docked pane on the right; line: one row above the prompt, no width taken. /progress opens the pane either way.

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: Width the docked pane asks for. A width you drag it to wins.
